flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it."
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of the product price as extra_fees (or "none").
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

listed_price.query: the first product's displayed listed price
listed_price.condition: The first product's displayed price is stored as {{listed_price}}.
listed_price.human_description: Reading the first product's displayed price

cart_unadded_items_present.query: whether any cart line other than the single listed AirWave Pro Earbuds line is present in the cart

cart_unadded_items_present.human_description: Checking whether additional cart items are present
cart_unadded_items_present.subject: anything else you did not add in the cart

final_total.query: the final order total amount in the review order summary
final_total.condition: The final order total shown on the review page is stored as {{final_total}}.
final_total.human_description: Reading the final total from the order summary

extra_fees.query: the names of fees added on top of the product price in the review order summary
extra_fees.condition: The names of any fees added on top of the product price are stored as {{extra_fees}} (or "none").
extra_fees.human_description: Reading added fee names from the order summary
extra_fees.code_js: (() => { const rows = [...el(9).querySelectorAll('.row')]; const fees = rows.filter(r => { const cells = r.querySelectorAll('span'); const name = cells[0]?.textContent.trim(); const amount = cells[1]?.textContent.trim(); return name && name !== 'Order total' && !name.includes('×') && amount && !/^free$/i.test(amount) && !/^\$?0(?:\.00)?$/.test(amount); }).map(r => r.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()); return fees.length ? fees.join(', ') : 'none'; })()
